paragraphs: Ordained by Bahá’u’lláh, the Universal House of Justice guides the worldwide Bahá’í community. Its nine members are elected every five years by the members of all National Spiritual Assemblies.

Its first election on 21 April 1963 followed the completion of the Ten Year Crusade and the interim custodianship of the Hands of the Cause. The establishment is also shown as a dated event in the timeline.
